knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The SA standard does not mandate colour coding for facilities in SA, and leaves adoption to each facility.
The purpose is to reduce cross-infection by keeping materials for each area separate.
The item must match its assigned area. Using the wrong colour defeats the scheme, so the cleaner swaps it or reports the gap.

practicalCriteria: Learner matches three sample items to their areas on a facility chart, with all three correct
Learner identifies a mismatched item in a sample set and states the action, with the correct action given
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor record of the matching exercise
stopWorkCriteria: An item of the wrong colour is found in a clinical area and the scheme is in use
